items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or results, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Risk is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and continue only existing read-only evidence work.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, TLS posture, and disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or requeue unchanged work.

Keep ordinary reversible growth conditional only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries. Keep security-sensitive releases blocked until material security evidence is complete.
